Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from the allowed mapping.
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract; performs an external call after state update.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Owner-only function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract to recover tokens.
